full_sentence: Look outside! The children are playing in the snow.

options.text: play in the snow every day.
options.why_wrong: The simple present describes habits. The stem asks for an action happening right now.
The past simple describes a finished action, not one happening at the moment of speaking.

options.text: will play in the snow tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: The future tense refers to tomorrow, not to the moment of speaking.

grammar_focus: Present continuous for actions happening now
explanation: The word Look signals a moment of speaking, so the action must be in progress now. The present continuous uses am, is or are with the -ing form.
